title: An item's expression sees the filter that selected it

source.quote: Here, we select two items on the calculation group, "item1" and "item2".
source.supports: the page's multipleOrEmptySelectionExpression reads FILTERS ( 'MyCalcGroup'[Name] ) and returns "Filters: item1, item2": code applied for a selection still sees the filter on the group

source.quote: For this reason it is possible to retrieve the current selection of Metric[Metric] from the filter context.
source.supports: a filter on a calculation group stays in the filter context while items are applied

derivation: The item is SELECTEDVALUE ( Info[Info] ); the filter Info[Info] = "Selected" is still in the filter context, so the value is "Selected".
alternative: If applying an item removed its own group's filter from the context its expression sees, SELECTEDVALUE ( Info[Info] ) would be BLANK (the group has four items).
